question: A bead workshop began with 94 tubs of beads. Each tub was emptied into 3 jars, and every jar was tipped into 2 pouches. The pouches were shared equally among the workshop's 3 tables, and the tutor sat at one of them. Each pouch on the tutor's table was opened into 2 dishes, and every dish holds 4 beads. A child then dropped 4 loose beads onto that table. The workshop lasts 90 minutes. How many beads are on the tutor's table?

A city car park records its takings in cents and banks them in dollars. On Monday there were 197 parking cards in the machine, and an attendant loaded 57 more. Each card is worth 5 tokens, and 842 tokens were used by drivers that week. A delivery firm then handed back 79 unused tokens. Every token the car park still holds is worth 5 cents, and 665 cents were paid out in refunds. Hasan handled more tokens that week than his colleague Mira did, and the car park has 300 spaces. How many cents does the car park hold?

A community radio station logs its airtime in minutes and prints the schedule in hours. Dev's programme slot began the month at 60 minutes. The manager added 28 minutes to the slot, then took 40 minutes away for a news bulletin. A sponsor bought 15 more minutes for the same slot, but 27 minutes were later given to a sports show and 17 minutes to a music hour. Dev's slot is still longer than his colleague Anita's slot. How many minutes long is Dev's slot now?

A hospital canteen times its serving rounds in minutes and reports them in hours. On Monday morning the freezer held 178 meals, and a delivery before lunch added 61. Early in the afternoon 21 meals arrived from another kitchen, and later that afternoon 21 more came in. In the evening 108 meals were served to patients, and a member of staff took 1 meal home. The canteen has 12 tables. How many meals are in the freezer now?

On Monday morning a wholesaler loaded 161 boxes of tea onto each of its 7 lorries. Before lunch a small van added 61 more boxes to the fleet. In the afternoon 101 boxes were dropped at a supermarket, and a returned order put 23 boxes back on board. In the evening the factory sent out 16 fresh boxes to the lorries. The drivers share a dozen flasks of coffee between them. How many boxes of tea are on the lorries now?

A bicycle shop had 66 wheels in its store, and 20 of them went back to the maker as faulty. Each remaining wheel needs 8 spokes, so the mechanic counted out that many spokes from the drawer. He used 170 spokes on repairs and later found 12 more in a toolbox. A wholesaler then bought 69 spokes from him. The spokes that were left were shared equally among the shop's 3 workbenches. The shop sells 40 bicycles a month. How many spokes are on one workbench?

On Monday morning a garden shed held 227 seed trays. Before lunch 85 trays went out to the allotment, and during the afternoon 134 trays were sold at the gate. In the evening the trays still in the shed were shared equally among 4 greenhouses, and the gardener took charge of the one nearest the gate. On Tuesday she carried 57 more trays into that greenhouse. On Wednesday a delivery made the number of trays in it 2 times as large. How many trays are in that greenhouse now?

A bakery weighs its flour in grams although the sacks are labelled in kilograms. On Monday the bakery had 164 tins of shortbread, and each tin was emptied into 6 paper bags for the market. The bags were shared equally among the 6 market stalls, and the stall by the church took its share. The stallholder was handed 65 more bags from the van, and she sold 167 bags during the day. A dozen paper flags decorate her stall. How many bags of shortbread does she still have?

A hotel laundry records its machine time in minutes and bills it to guests in hours. On Monday the linen store held 155 towels, and a delivery added 69 more. Housekeeping then took 130 towels out to the rooms. A wash returned 26 towels to the store, and a guest handed back 3 more. Each towel now in the store is packed into a welcome basket with 8 small soaps. How many soaps go into the baskets altogether?

A stationery factory filled 53 cartons on each of its 8 production lines. A night shift then packed 77 more cartons. Every carton holds 6 notebooks, and all of them were sent to the warehouse. A returned order added 35 notebooks to the warehouse, and a college sent back 60 more. A dozen forklifts work in that warehouse. How many notebooks are in the warehouse?

A theatre counts its box office money in cents and pays it into the bank in dollars. The stalls have 55 rows, and each row holds 8 seats. A balcony adds 67 more seats, but 142 seats were closed off for repairs. Every seat still in use was sold for 5 cents at the charity matinee, and 62 cents were later refunded to a family who left early. The theatre was built in 1908. How many cents did the theatre keep?

A brick works measures its output in kilograms and reports it to the council in tonnes. On Monday the yard held 117 pallets of bricks, and a delivery added 67 more pallets. A second yard then opened, making the number of pallets 2 times as large. Every pallet carries 6 crates, each crate holds 7 bundles, and each bundle holds 7 bricks. How many bricks does the works hold?

On Monday morning a school canteen had 193 cartons of juice in the chiller. Before break 21 cartons were sold, and at lunchtime 60 more were taken. In the early afternoon a supplier delivered 53 cartons, and in the evening a sports club donated 57 more. Each carton in the chiller fills 8 small cups. How many cups of juice can the canteen pour?

On Saturday morning a fishmonger had 220 salmon fillets and shared them equally among his 4 market stalls. Ola took the fillets for the stall on the quay. Before lunch she sold 32 fillets from it. In the afternoon the van brought her enough salmon to make her stock 4 times as large as it then was. In the evening she sold another 32 fillets and still finished with more stock than her colleague Bjorn had at his stall. A dozen gulls waited on the roof all day. How many fillets does Ola have left?

On Monday morning a school hall held 90 chairs, and the caretaker carried half of them into the gym. During the afternoon a delivery made the number of chairs in the gym 4 times as large. In the evening a second delivery doubled the number of chairs in the gym again. On Tuesday a teacher brought 64 more chairs into the gym. On Wednesday the school borrowed enough chairs from a neighbouring school to make the gym hold 3 times as many as it then did. On Thursday another 32 chairs were carried in from the library. How many chairs are in the gym now?

Dmitri's bakery had 132 sacks of flour in the store, and the mill sent 14 more. Each sack fills 5 trays of dough, and every tray is cut into 8 rolls. A neighbour then donated 25 baked rolls to the shop. Dmitri has more rolls this week than his rival Ana does, and his oven takes 40 minutes to heat up. How many rolls does Dmitri have?

A brewery had 230 barrels in its cellar, and 40 of them were sent away for repair. Each remaining barrel fills 5 kegs. A second cellar was then opened, which doubled the number of kegs the brewery holds. Every keg fills 4 crates of bottles. Piotr looks after more kegs than his colleague Hana does, and the brewery was founded 60 years ago. How many crates of bottles can the brewery fill?

A stamp club began the year with 181 albums in its store. Members donated 15 albums, then 17 more, and later another 24. Each album in the store holds 6 rare stamps. A collector then gave the club 29 loose stamps as well. Ines has donated more albums than Karl has, and a dozen members meet every Thursday. How many stamps does the club hold?

On Monday morning a jam factory had 202 crates of fruit, and 29 crates were found spoiled and thrown away. Each good crate holds 9 punnets, and every punnet holds 3 handfuls of berries. In the afternoon a farmer brought 33 more handfuls of berries to the factory. In the evening all of the berries were shared equally among the factory's 6 boiling kettles. How many handfuls of berries are in one kettle?

Amira's warehouse held 214 boxes of pens, and a supplier delivered 47 more. Each box holds 6 packets of pens. A cancelled order then put 50 loose packets on the shelves, and a school bought 278 packets. Amira keeps more packets in stock than her colleague Rashid does, and the warehouse has 18 loading doors. How many packets of pens are in the warehouse?

A cannery filled 145 crates on each of its 4 production lines, and a night shift added 78 more crates. Every crate in the store holds 4 tins of soup. During the week 856 tins were sold to a supermarket. The manager then sent half of the tins that were left to a food bank and kept the rest in the store. How many tins did the food bank receive?

A logistics depot records its journeys in minutes and reports them in hours. On Monday morning each of the 7 vans was loaded with 163 parcels. Before lunch 469 parcels were delivered, and during the afternoon another 266 went out. In the evening the parcels still on board were split equally between the depot's 2 night lorries, and the first lorry set off with its share. Each parcel on that lorry holds 8 packets, and every packet holds 3 leaflets. How many leaflets are on that lorry?

A phone shop records call time in minutes but prints it on the bills in hours. On Monday morning the shop had 213 handsets in stock. Before lunch 130 handsets were sold to a company. In the early afternoon a delivery brought 33 more. Later that afternoon the stock was split equally between the shop's 2 branches, and the manager stayed with the branch on the high street. In the evening a supplier added 35 handsets to that branch, and a courier took 43 away for repair. How many handsets are at the high street branch now?

A school tuck shop counts its takings in cents and banks them in dollars. The float in the tin was 15 cents on Monday morning. Sales added 37 cents, then 66 cents, then 63 cents to the same tin. The head teacher then matched the money several times over so that the tin held 5 times as much as it had. A parent later dropped 69 cents into the tin, and a teacher added 9 cents. How many cents are in the tin now?

Yara had 89 marbles in her bag at the start of the week. She lost 2 down a drain and gave 79 away to her cousins. She traded 7 more for a comic. Her friend Kwame, who keeps fewer marbles than Yara does, gave her 18 from his own bag, and her grandmother added 4 more. Yara then dropped 10 marbles into a charity jar. How many marbles are in Yara's bag now?
